OUR WORK / US Industrial Valve Manufacturer / IN PROGRESS

A digital experience for industrial flow control.

A clearer, more credible digital experience for a specialist industrial valve portfolio, built around technical buyers and the applications the products serve.

Client
US Industrial Valve Manufacturer
Sector
Industrial valves and flow control
Primary capability
Experience Design & Enablement
Status
In Progress

PROJECT CONTEXT

A digital experience for the work of flow control.

A US industrial valve manufacturer is building a new digital experience around its product portfolio and the applications those products serve. The work brings product information and application context into one experience. The engagement remains in progress, and the client is published anonymously.

SCOPE

  • Website experience and UX
  • Industrial content and product architecture
  • Interface design
  • Responsive development

01 / The challenge

Make a specialist portfolio credible and clear.

Present a specialist industrial product portfolio in a clearer, more credible digital experience for technical buyers and decision-makers. Industrial information needs a structure that connects what a product is with where it is used.

02 / What InnooRyze is doing

Translate complexity into an experience.

Translate complex product and application information into an intuitive, responsive digital experience with stronger hierarchy and easier exploration. The work connects content structure, interface design and responsive development.

03 / What is being built

A connected industrial product experience.

The current build presents valve products and application information through a digital experience that is still being refined. The interface shown represents the digital-experience concept; it does not represent a completed launch.
